reason: Historical player game logs do exist, including NFL.com 1970 logs. No evaluated 1950–1998 source yet established both complete scorer-relevant game fields and a verified permission basis for this database import. Profile dates and franchise founding dates are not game records.

sourceLeads.name: NFL.com historical player game logs
sourceLeads.status: Verified 1970 individual game logs exist. Not imported: systematic database retrieval requires prior written consent under NFL terms §1.3, and scorer-relevant blank fields require verification rather than zero-filling.

sourceLeads.name: NFL/team media guides and gamebooks
sourceLeads.status: Historical evidence; abbreviated summaries are incomplete for the current scoring rules; reuse permission unverified.

sourceLeads.name: Pro Football Researchers Association
sourceLeads.status: Archival gamebooks have access restrictions; membership does not establish dataset redistribution rights.

sourceLeads.name: Sportradar NFL historical coverage
sourceLeads.status: Standard documented coverage starts in 2000; does not resolve 1950–1980.

sourceLeads.name: Stats Perform historical data
sourceLeads.status: Advertises football history from 1920; requires written field/season matrix, sample verification and appropriate license. No purchase or outreach made.

identityGuardrails: 1950 Baltimore Colts are separate from the Colts franchise that began in 1953.
1952 NFL Dallas Texans are separate from the AFL Dallas Texans (1960–1962), now Kansas City.
Cleveland retains Browns history; no Browns games in 1996–1998. Baltimore Ravens begin in 1996.
importRule: Unknown scoring values stay unknown. Reject incomplete games; never substitute invented zeros.
reviewSelectionBias: Shutout-selected low-scoring sample, not representative career performances; excluded from normal drafts, draws and seasons.
